# Samori World

> Samori World is a travel guide and comparison site. It publishes destination and neighbourhood guides, and links to booking partners for flights, hotels, car rental, tours and attractions, and eSIMs. Some links are affiliate links; the site earns a commission if you book through them, at no extra cost to you. Bookings are completed with the partner, not on this site.

Each guide covers where to stay, what to see, how to get there and how to get around.

## Destination guides

- [Abu Dhabi Travel Guide — Culture & Yas Island](https://www.samori.net/destinations/abu-dhabi/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Abu Dhabi: where to stay, the mosque and museums, Yas Island's parks, a desert safari, and a sample itinerary.
- [Brazzaville Travel Guide — Hotels & Sights](https://www.samori.net/destinations/brazzaville/): Brazzaville travel guide: where to stay, riverside terraces, the Basilique Sainte-Anne and day trips to the Lesio-Louna gorillas.
- [Conkouati-Douli National Park Guide](https://www.samori.net/destinations/conkouati/): Guide to Conkouati-Douli National Park, Republic of Congo: gorillas, forest elephants, chimpanzee islands, humpback whales and how to get there.
- [Doha Travel Guide — Souqs, Skyline & Desert](https://www.samori.net/destinations/doha/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Doha: where to stay
between West Bay and The Pearl, the best souqs, museums and desert safaris,
and a sample itinerary.
- [Dubai Travel Guide — Towers, Palm & Desert](https://www.samori.net/destinations/dubai/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Dubai: the Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah, the Marina, a desert day out, and a sample itinerary.
- [Istanbul Travel Guide — Domes & Bazaars](https://www.samori.net/destinations/istanbul/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Istanbul: Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, the Grand Bazaar, a Bosphorus ferry, and a sample itinerary.
- [Kenya Travel Guide — Safari, Coast & Nairobi](https://www.samori.net/destinations/kenya/): Kenya travel guide: safari in the Maasai Mara and Amboseli, Nairobi's Giraffe Centre, coast stays, best time to go and where to fly into.
- [Kinshasa Travel Guide — Hotels & Sights](https://www.samori.net/destinations/kinshasa/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Kinshasa: where to stay, what to see, and how to get there — no stock photography, just the real thing.
- [Kuala Lumpur Travel Guide — Skyline & Food](https://www.samori.net/destinations/kuala-lumpur/): Kuala Lumpur travel guide: Petronas Towers, Jalan Alor street food, KLCC and Bukit Bintang hotels, malls and a simple 4-day route.
- [London Destination Guide](https://www.samori.net/destinations/london/): London travel guide: where to stay, what to see, and where to eat. Royal history, riverside icons, and a hotel scene built for a splurge.
- [Los Angeles Destination Guide](https://www.samori.net/destinations/los-angeles/): Los Angeles travel guide: where to stay, what to see and where to eat, from Hollywood and Griffith Observatory to the Getty.
- [Manchester Travel Guide — Football & Museums](https://www.samori.net/destinations/manchester/): Manchester travel guide: where to stay, museums and libraries, football history and music heritage, plus how to get there.
- [Marrakech Travel Guide — Palaces & Souks](https://www.samori.net/destinations/marrakech/): Marrakech travel guide: where to stay, Bahia Palace, Jardin Majorelle, Jemaa el-Fnaa, rooftop dining and a simple 4-day route.
- [Mauritius Travel Guide — Beaches & Le Morne](https://www.samori.net/destinations/mauritius/): Mauritius travel guide: beaches, islands, waterfalls and Le Morne, with where to stay and how to get around the island.
- [Muanda Travel Guide — Hotels & Sights](https://www.samori.net/destinations/muanda/): Muanda travel guide: Atlantic beaches, Mangroves National Park, sea turtles, where to stay and eat, and how to get there.
- [New York Travel Guide — Skyline & Museums](https://www.samori.net/destinations/new-york/): Plan your New York trip: where to stay in Midtown, the sights worth the line, Central Park, Broadway, and how to get in and out of JFK without the stress.
- [Paris Travel Guide — Icons & Neighborhoods](https://www.samori.net/destinations/paris/): Everything you need to plan a Paris trip — where to stay, what to see, day trips to Versailles, and a simple route to follow.
- [Pointe-Noire Travel Guide — Hotels & Sights](https://www.samori.net/destinations/pointe-noire/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Pointe-Noire: where to stay, where to eat, what to see, and how to get there by air or from Pointe-Noire.
- [Rome Travel Guide — Ruins, Piazzas & Pasta](https://www.samori.net/destinations/rome/): Rome travel guide: where to stay, the Vatican, Colosseum and Trevi Fountain, rooftop dining, getting there and a 4-day route.
- [Seychelles Travel Guide — Beaches & Islands](https://www.samori.net/destinations/seychelles/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Seychelles: Anse Lazio, Anse Source d'Argent, Vallée de Mai, where to stay, and a sample itinerary.
- [Singapore Travel Guide — Gardens & Hawkers](https://www.samori.net/destinations/singapore/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Singapore: Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay, hawker centres, the southern islands, and a sample itinerary.
- [Tokyo Destination Guide](https://www.samori.net/destinations/tokyo/): Tokyo travel guide: where to stay, what to see, and where to eat. Senso-ji, Shibuya, Ginza, Shinjuku and the best gardens and hotels.
- [Johannesburg Travel Guide](https://www.samori.net/destinations/johannesburg/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Johannesburg: the Apartheid Museum, Soweto, Sandton, safari parks on the city’s doorstep, and a sample itinerary.
- [Cairo Travel Guide](https://www.samori.net/destinations/cairo/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Cairo: the Pyramids of Giza, the Grand Egyptian Museum, the Citadel, where to stay, and a sample itinerary.
- [Barcelona Travel Guide](https://www.samori.net/destinations/barcelona/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Barcelona: Gaudí's Sagrada Família, the Gothic Quarter, La Boqueria, where to stay, and a sample itinerary.
- [Maldives Travel Guide](https://www.samori.net/destinations/maldives/): Everything you need to plan a trip to the Maldives: snorkelling, sandbanks, where to stay, how to get to the islands, and a sample itinerary.

## Where to stay

- [Where to Stay in Doha](https://www.samori.net/hotels/where-to-stay-in-doha/): Doha is compact compared to other Gulf cities, but the areas still feel distinct — modern skyline, old-world souq, or man-made island resort.
- [Where to Stay in Dubai](https://www.samori.net/hotels/where-to-stay-in-dubai/): Where to stay in Dubai: how to choose the right area in a spread-out city, plus the stays and experiences worth booking alongside it.
- [Where to Stay in Kenya](https://www.samori.net/hotels/where-to-stay-in-kenya/): Kenya isn't a one-base trip — most itineraries split time between Nairobi, a safari region, and often the coast. Here's how to structure it.
- [Where to Stay in London](https://www.samori.net/hotels/where-to-stay-in-london/): Where to stay in London: choosing the right area for history and icons, riverside culture or a more local, less touristy feel.

## Search and booking tools

- [Compare Flights Worldwide](https://www.samori.net/flights/): Search and compare flights across many airlines and booking sites at once, then book directly with the provider you choose.
- [Hotels — Find Your Stay](https://www.samori.net/hotels/): Search hotels in our favourite destinations and book on Klook, with free cancellation on many stays. Compare stays before you book.
- [Car Rental — Find a Rental Car](https://www.samori.net/car-rental/): Rent a car wherever you travel: search local rental companies with Localrent or compare other partners, with clear prices and low deposits.
- [Things to Do – Tours & Attractions](https://www.samori.net/things-to-do/): Book tours and attractions worldwide with skip-the-line tickets, real reviews, vetted operators and free cancellation on most bookings.
- [Travel eSIMs](https://www.samori.net/esim/): Compare travel eSIM providers for Europe, the US, Asia and global trips, and check phone compatibility before you buy.

## About

- [Contact Us](https://www.samori.net/contact/): Contact Samori World. We can't see, change or cancel bookings, so for tickets, changes or refunds contact the company you booked with.
